div.h1: D11 · Phonetic regex → NFA → (NFA × Levenshtein × Dictionary) product

text.tspan: The compiled NFA accepts both branches of the alternation (ph or f) before 'o','n','e'.
PhoneticNfaWfst exposes the bare NFA (lazy subset construction); PhoneticWfst fuses it with
the dictionary and a Levenshtein bound. Exact alternation matches cost phonetic_weight; edits cost 1.
